reading: On the current die MTP ~= AR (x0.99 fixed table; x0.75 measured-unit sensitivity): the verify of 6 positions costs 3.56x an AR token because every per-position engine record (FUSED HC pre-norm/post, HC mix+Sinkhorn, SM attention, per-position gathers/merges, IDX) runs one position at a time, and the row-serial DSpark draft adds 331k cycles (13%). Collectives and weight streams, shared across positions, are not what binds.

gaps.item: smh carries op_xb only: no P-slot count (HGI-1 spec 6.7 / record param [4:2]); as built costs +401.5k cycles a step (1,990 -> 1,716 tok/s)
attention-on-SM per position x6 (each query re-streams its window/top-k lines): multi-query QK/PV op sharing KV lines across the 6 positions saves up to 267k cycles

FUSED HC_PRE_NORM / HC_POST / QDQ and HC_MIX(+Sinkhorn) take one position per record: P-row records (pipelined) save 356k (FUSED) + 311k (HC); measured FUSED ratios 6.5-20x make this the sensitivity binder

per-position ROW_GATHER / TOPK_MERGE / kv-row gathers (save 202k if batched) and IDX.INDEX / route TOPK (94k); no HGI-1 record for the verify expert union (priced as one IDX.TOPK a layer; closed ot_dshbm_expert_union_m not bound); ARGMAX static x6 + merge for the verify head
